For independent learners

Go from curious to job-ready, at your own pace.

Whether you're switching careers or studying for your first certification, start free and learn by doing. A short placement test drops you in at the right level, and hands-on labs make the concepts stick — no prior IT background needed.

  • Start free — the first labs are open to everyone, no credit card
  • Adaptive placement puts you at the right level, not back at zero
  • Hands-on labs — SIEM triage, packet analysis, incident response, not just videos
  • CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701) aligned path with a certificate of completion

For parents & curious beginners

A safe place for your kid to learn real cyber skills.

Same real tools as the pro version, reshaped into a friendly, encouraging experience. Your child learns how phishing works, why passwords matter, and how attackers think — guided by BYTE, a companion that keeps them motivated with streaks and small wins instead of pressure.

  • Designed for curious beginners — no jargon wall, no fear tactics
  • You approve first — parental sign-off before your child starts, and you can see their progress
  • No countdown timers or manipulative prompts, ever
  • The skills are genuinely real: the same platform professionals train on, made age-appropriate
For schools & training programs

Cybersecurity training your students will actually finish.

Built for classrooms and programs. Every lab maps to CompTIA Security+ domains, so it slots into an existing curriculum instead of replacing it. Assign labs, track completion, and let students learn at their own level with an adaptive placement test.

  • Curriculum-mapped to Security+ (SY0-701) and NIST CSF
  • Teacher dashboard: assign, monitor progress, see who's stuck
  • Adaptive start — a short placement test puts each student at the right level
  • Academic-integrity built in: AI-assisted work is flagged and earns no XP
